off_recording.how: fixtures/off-golden.json was written by tests/responses_run_budget.rs off_control::records_the_off_golden, run against the unchanged production code of base_sha in a fresh git-archive copy of that commit with its own target (re-recorded in F6 outside the worktree; only tests/responses_run_budget.rs added to the copy; its src/ is the archive's), with no wallet selected; the compatible paths go to a fake on 127.0.0.1, the direct path to a proxy on 127.0.0.1 that closes each CONNECT; every off path runs in a root of exactly 128 bytes after canonicalization (World::fixed_length), so the prompt-size estimates that count the raw workspace path are the same on every host
off_recording.command: RESPONSES_RUN_BUDGET_OFF_OUT=<out> HEAVY_LOCK_CLASS=cargo with-heavy-lock cargo test -j 4 --test responses_run_budget -- --exact off_control::records_the_off_golden, run in the base copy twice with the default TMPDIR and once with TMPDIR=/tmp; the three outputs were byte-identical (cmp)
normalization: the run's temporary root -> <ROOT>; the fake's loopback address -> <LOOPBACK>: each run makes its own (two raw base runs: every request body and workspace_root differ only by the temporary root)

a non-negative integer under duration_ms, occurred_at_epoch_ms, executor_ms, provider_ms, total_ms, time_profile_provider_ms, time_profile_total_ms -> 0, any other type kept: in the two raw base runs every occurrence of each key differed (duration_ms 20/20, occurred_at_epoch_ms 12/12, executor_ms 12/12, provider_ms 12/12, total_ms 12/12, time_profile_provider_ms 6/6, time_profile_total_ms 6/6)

a string under build_commit or build_timestamp -> <BUILD>: equal within the base's two runs (unknown/unknown) and different from the current build (commit and build time) in all 12 occurrences; they name the binary

a boolean under build_dirty -> <BUILD>: equal in the two raw base runs and in the current build (false, 12/12); kept normalized because it is the state of the building tree, not the run: any build from a tree with an uncommitted edit (a developer's change, an in-place mutation) reports true with no change in behaviour
in .commandagent/lock, pid and run_id -> <PID>, <RUN>: both differed between the two raw base runs on every path

in a bash_sandbox_status event, a backend string that is seatbelt, landlock or none -> <SANDBOX_BACKEND>, any other value or type kept: the host's OS sandbox (seatbelt on macOS, landlock on Linux; PR #1011 CI and results/L-196/ac7-linux/findings.md), not the run's

not normalized: estimated_prompt_tokens_sent, estimated_stable_prefix_chars and their sums; they follow the length of the raw workspace path (results/L-196/ac7-linux/findings.md), which the fixed 128-byte root makes equal on every host; a temporary directory longer than 126 bytes fails the test
every other value is compared as it is
